string.text: Do you perform armor upgrades?
Yes, I can. But only with Hermann's authorization.
Understood.
Professor, may I obtain authorization to upgrade my equipment?
Young man, your timing is excellent! We are running out of consumable material. We need more samples and someone willing to find them.
What do you need?
Bring us two... No, three natural artefacts of any class from I through IV. Their classes and families may be the same.
Understood. I will return with the samples.
Professor, I brought the artefacts. Here they are. May I have the upgrade authorization?
Excellent! It could not be better. First we must measure the gamma emissions, and then...
Excuse me, Professor, but what about...
Yes, yes, I remember. I give my verbal authorization for rank-one field modifications to your equipment. Technical specialist Novikov, did you hear that?
*Silence*
He probably heard everything.
Professor, I would like authorization for Novikov's second upgrade level.
Young man! Certainly. But we need more stable structures... That is, more active artefacts for our research. Bring us two modificats and one mesomodificat, all from different families.
Understood. I will try to find them.
Professor, I brought the artefacts for the Stable Structures study. Here they are.
The entire mobile laboratory thanks you!
I remember, I remember. I authorize rank-two field modifications. Assistant Novikov, did you hear that?
We shall assume he did.
Professor, I would li...
Young man, you have already helped us enormously. You may call me Hermann now.
Very well, Professor Hermann. I would like third-level authorization.

Of course, I would gladly issue it, but there is a problem. Our superiors demand results—results from limiting states. Ah, if you helped us again, I would gladly allow you to use every service of our mobile laboratory.
Of course I will help. What do you require?
We need only one Absolute-class artefact and, preferably, two hypermodificates—all from different families.
Understood. I will find them.
Professor Hermann! I am back.
How glad I am to see you! I hope you did not return empty-handed?
Not empty-handed, Professor. I collected these especially for you. Here.
You cannot imagine how much you have helped us. Stay in the laboratory as long as you like; you will always be welcome here.
And the authorization?
Ah, yes. I authorized that old silent fellow before you returned. I never doubted you for a second...
Thank you, Professor.
Anomalous Materials
Hermann needs any three natural artefacts of classes I–IV. Their classes and families may be the same. Keep eligible items in the rucksack; belt and slotted items are ignored.
Stable Structures
Hermann needs two modificats and one mesomodificat, all from different families. Keep eligible items in the rucksack; belt and slotted items are ignored.
Limiting States
Hermann needs one Absolute and two hypermodificates. All three artefacts must belong to different families and be kept in the rucksack.
Hermann's authorization for rank-one field modifications is required
Hermann's authorization for rank-two field modifications is required
Hermann's authorization for rank-three field modifications is required
